preparedFields.accessesPersonalInformation: Yes — user-selected project files may contain personal information (responsible, assignee and revision fields); optional local MCP clients can read the design. No automatic developer analytics or project upload.
preparedFields.certificationNotes: Desktop dataflow designer and code generator. No login, subscription or external server is needed; the app starts its own backend bound to 127.0.0.1. Test with keyboard and mouse: open an example .orch from the portable release (examples/webserver-rust.orch), use the Designer tab, select an entity and open the Editor tab. Code checks, completion and hover need clang/clangd or rust-analyzer installed separately; without them the editor still works with syntax colors. The optional MCP server binds only to 127.0.0.1 with a bearer token; external agent clients are separate. The interface is English; Store descriptions and captions are localized. Needs graphics drivers supporting DirectX 11.
